statusLine.command: input=$(cat); cwd=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir // .cwd // empty' 2>/dev/null || echo $(pwd)); user=$(whoami); hostname=$(hostname -s); msystem=${MSYSTEM:-}; git_branch=""; if git rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1; then branch=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$branch" ] && git_branch=" ($branch)"; fi; status="${user}@${hostname}"; [ -n "$msystem" ] && status="${status} ${msystem}"; short_cwd=$(basename "$cwd"); printf "%s %s%s" "$status" "$short_cwd" "$git_branch"
